$comment: Source of truth for model-role effort levels (extensions/model-tiers.ts, policy in harness/model-tiers/plan.ts). The user picks the model of each role in config.yml modelRoles; this file sets only the level. A role without `above` runs its model at that model's sweet spot (or the role's fixed `effort`); a role with `above` runs the named role's model at the next level whose benchmark index gains (points), or one level up without points. A level the user changes by hand stays until the model of that role is picked again. A model without a sweet spot here is queued for research (model_tiers tool, action record).
